cells.label: fact
cells.reason: Merrill's Form ADV and web materials disclose substantial detail about advisor compensation structure (salary, incentive/production credits, grids, recruitment payments, management compensation), so these are facts about what the firm discloses.

items.text: Merrill states it pays Advisors a salary and incentive compensation based on the revenues Merrill receives for Program Services and brokerage services, with Advisors credited 'production credits' from a portion of the Merrill Lynch Fee, Sales Charges from brokerage securities transactions, margin lending, cash swept to Bank Affiliates, and referrals of clients for banking, lending and other financial services.
items.quote: We pay Advisors a salary and incentive compensation that is based on the revenues Merrill receives for making available and/or providing Program Services as well as for the brokerage services provided to clients with brokerage accounts. In general, an Advisor is credited in the form of "production credits" with a portion of the Merrill Lynch Fee paid and, for brokerage accounts, the Sales Charges received from securities transactions.

items.text: Merrill discloses that an Advisor earns compensation based on the revenue Merrill earns from the Merrill Lynch Fee, other fees and costs not covered by the Merrill Lynch Fee, Sales Charges from brokerage securities transactions, and revenue from referrals to Affiliates including for banking products or services.
items.quote: Your Advisor earns compensation based on the revenue that Merrill earns from the Merrill Lynch Fee paid by you in the Program and other revenue derived from certain, but not all, of the other fees and costs you incur that are not covered by the Merrill Lynch Fee. They also earn compensation based on the revenue that Merrill earns from Sales Charges related to securities transactions in any brokerage account you may have as well as from the revenue derived from the referrals to Affiliates (including referrals to an Affiliate for banking products or services).

items.text: Merrill discloses that Advisors receive production credits toward their compensation formula based on the Merrill Lynch Fee, and that Advisors receive 10% or more fewer production credits if the weighted average Merrill Lynch Fee Rate for a client's Accounts (and Household Accounts) falls below rate levels for specific wealth asset tiers Merrill establishes.
items.quote: In general, Advisors receive "production credits" toward their compensation formula based on the amount of the Merrill Lynch Fee that you pay for your Account. Merrill's policies result in Advisors receiving fewer production credits (by 10% or more) if the weighted average of the Merrill Lynch Fee Rates for a client's Accounts and for Accounts that are part of the Household is lower than the rate levels for specific wealth asset tiers that Merrill establishes.

items.text: Merrill discloses that the higher the Merrill Lynch Fee Rate a client agrees to, the more the Advisor earns in production credits, and the more production credits an Advisor generates, the higher the Advisor's incentive compensation.
items.quote: The higher the Merrill Lynch Fee Rate you agree to, the more your Advisor earns in production credits. The more overall production credits that an Advisor generates, the higher the Advisor's incentive compensation.

items.text: Merrill discloses that Advisors are eligible for a compensation award, payable over a defined period, from an incentive program based on meeting prior-year growth targets in new households and in assets and liabilities (including investment activity, new trust accounts, 401(k) accounts, and banking/lending participation), and that an Advisor's incentive compensation grid is reduced if they fail to achieve growth for two consecutive years in the assets and liabilities component.
items.quote: Advisors are eligible to receive a compensation award, payable over a defined period of time, from an incentive program that is currently based on meeting growth targets from the prior year in new households and in assets and liabilities. ... An Advisor is subject to a reduction in their incentive compensation grid if they fail to achieve growth for two consecutive years in the assets and liabilities component of the award.

items.text: Merrill discloses that Advisors who join from other firms generally receive recruitment payments that may take forms including salary guarantees, upfront awards, and compensation contingent on continued employment such as deferred payments and recruitment loans, generally based largely on the size of their prior business, and that these bonuses are in addition to their incentive compensation.
items.quote: Advisors who join Merrill from other firms generally receive payments in connection with that move. These payments may take various forms, including salary guarantees, upfront awards and various forms of compensation contingent on continued employment (e.g., deferred payments, recruitment loans). ... These bonuses are in addition to the incentive compensation to which they are otherwise entitled as Advisors.

items.text: Merrill discloses that elements of its field management compensation are based on revenues to Merrill and on the financial advisors they manage meeting strategic goals set for the year, and that Merrill management and other employees receive incentive compensation based on factors including the profitability of Merrill and BofA Corp.
items.quote: Elements of our field management compensation are based on revenues to Merrill and based on the financial advisors whom they manage meeting strategic goals set for the year, including the growth in assets and liabilities component of the award as described in the subsection "Advisor Compensation and Awards." Management personnel of Merrill and other employees of Merrill, MAA and their Affiliates receive incentive compensation based on a number of factors including the profitability of Merrill and BofA Corp.

items.text: Merrill's Advisor Development Program web page discloses that advisor roles include a base salary and unlimited earning potential.
items.quote: Base salary and unlimited earning potential

items.text: Merrill discloses that for Program Accounts, Advisors are compensated based on the Merrill Lynch Fee charged on the Account (based on the agreed-upon fee rate and asset value including cash), and that Advisors receive increased compensation for achieving strategic objectives such as growth in clients' participation in banking services and Lending Programs, but do not receive additional compensation for advisory client assets held in the Cash Sweep Program.
items.quote: For Program Accounts, Advisors are compensated based on the Merrill Lynch Fee charged on the Account which is based on the agreed-upon Merrill Lynch Fee Rate and the value of the assets in the Account, including cash balances and cash alternatives swept under the Cash Sweep Program. ... Advisors do not receive additional compensation as a result of advisory client assets held in the Cash Sweep Program.

items.text: Merrill discloses that it calculates the compensation paid to its Advisors on the same basis for all Program assets and without regard to the amount of any additional compensation Merrill or its Affiliates receive in connection with certain investments, and that Advisors do not receive any portion of, or credit for, compensation paid to Merrill or its Affiliates.
items.quote: calculating the compensation paid to our Advisors on the same basis for all Program assets and without regard to the amount of any Additional AI Compensation Merrill or our Affiliates receive in connection with the Investments.
